title: Reading a Poem: Layers of Meaning
goal: I can describe how I read a poem with a *-va/-ve* participle (*a verset elolvasva*, *a képeket dekódolva*).
I can say from which point of view I read it (*hermeneutikai szempontból vizsgálva*).
I can name the layers of meaning in a poem (*jelentésréteg*, *esztétikai kód*, *értelmezési keret*).

sections.title: Unit 33: Hungarian Literary Modernism
body: Around the journal Nyugat (founded in 1908), Hungarian writers brought Hungarian literature close to the rest of Europe.

This unit is built around Babits Mihály's book *Az európai irodalom története* (1934–1935). You recap participles, duty, comparison and *ahogyan … úgy*, and learn the words for writing about literature.
